_meta.purpose: Score CONVERSATIONAL quality, which the golden suite cannot. The golden judge grades every answer on factual grounding and detail, so a correct short reply to 'Hey! How are you?' scores 1.33/5 — penalising exactly the behaviour we want. These cases are scored on brevity, staying on the point, and not volunteering group facts nobody asked for.
_meta.expected_mode: the intent the router should pick; a mismatch is itself a failure
_meta.note: Example copy with member names replaced. The real probe lives at data/conversation_probe.json (gitignored, like golden_test_conversations.json).
_meta.history: optional: the '<Who>: <text>' lines already in this chat. Every case used to run with no history at all, so the probe only ever scored a first question — while every logged routing failure was a follow-up.
_meta.accept: optional: other modes that also pass. For cases with more than one defensible answer, so the probe records the requirement rather than one arbitrary choice.
_meta.must_contain_any: optional: the reply fails unless it contains one of these (case-insensitive substrings). Used for cases whose whole point is that the bot complied.
